abilities.effect: Deals 9999 damage to ALL enemies within 3.5 m. Damage lands ~0.24 s into the clip; tile frees immediately.
abilities.name: Proximity Detonation
abilities.trigger: Any enemy within 2.0 m once armed — or any bite landing on an armed pod

clipAnnotations.die: Eaten while still buried: standard pop-out death, no explosion.
clipAnnotations.attack: Valves burst open with flash star; lethal blast 0.24 s in.
clipAnnotations.grow: Pod rises out of the ground and arms.
clipAnnotations.underground: Buried idle: pod tip peeking like a periscope. Still bitable — no hiding.

mechanism: One-shot explosive (Potato Mine role). Buried and harmless for 5 s, then arms. An armed pod detonates when any enemy enters 2.0 m, or instantly when bitten. The 3.5 m blast kills everything (9999 dmg). Shovel defuses an armed pod instead of detonating it.
name: Popping Pod
subtitle: Bursting Pod
